We supported the legislation to deliver no tax on tips and no tax on overtime pay.

The money you earned belongs to you. Washington has been taking too much of it for too long. Not anymore.

The server pulling double shifts on a Saturday night. The nurse clocking in before sunrise. The construction worker grinding through the summer heat. The single mom picking up every extra hour she can get.

Your tips are yours. Your overtime is yours. We made sure of it.

South Carolina STRONG.
